item.title: LinkedIn Uses OpenTelemetry to Trace the Member Journey from Tap to Backend
item.description: LinkedIn has built an OpenTelemetry-based telemetry platform that connects what members do in its iOS, Android, and web applications with the backend services processing those interactions. By Craig Risi (1 source: infoq)

item.title: What a room of engineers asked me about realtime resilience
item.description: How Ably plans for CDN, DNS and regional failure, keeps messages in order across regions, and has gone more than 7 years without a global outage. (1 source: sreweekly)
